environment.execution: CPU-only ES-module contract and geometry checks; no browser, server, provider or GPU context

geometryContract.representation: Axis-aligned company-local rectangles and flat circles; department graph
geometryContract.units: Abstract interface world units; no physical length inferred
geometryContract.axes: Core x/y map to renderer world X/Z; world Y is a renderer depth layer
geometryContract.topology: Planar open shapes; no manifold, watertightness or physical-engineering claim

results.name: frozen exports, limits, deterministic seed, and canonical seed identities
independent fixture normalization and invalid graph/schema rejection
same-name company records stay isolated through successful workflow and reload
creation remains local, IDs survive same-clock additions, and parentage grants no ownership
shared identity and nested scope eligibility use explicit assignments
failed mutations reject before any partial commit
global capacities and hierarchy boundaries are inclusive and atomic
queries are copied, pure, bounded, and exclude the restricted placeholder
storage adapters round-trip scoped data and fail without mutation
geometry predicates honor whole footprints and finite-input boundaries
nested layout bounds, sibling separation, radius and automatic spacing are independent
movement changes presentation only and clamps full circle/note footprints

limitations: No actual WebGL initialization, GPU compositing, browser hit testing, visual or accessibility-tree evidence.
Scope checks validate local record relationships and owner eligibility, not real grants or authentication.
Renderer camera and spring modules require separate source handoff; they are not imported or simulated by this harness.
The prior standalone prototype 15-group receipt remains historical and is not evidence for this core.
